Smart Tourist Safety Platform :
Developed a full-stack web application to enhance tourist safety using the MERN stack and Google 
Gemini AI. Implemented features such as emergency SOS alerts, incident reporting, and an AI-powered

coordination to streamline the farm-to-consumer supply chain.

frontend , database using MongoDB and Implemented a secure RESTful API with Node.js for user
authentication (JWT) and chat persistence, and integrated a separate Python/Flask microservice using a
Sentence-BERT model for real-time semantic search.
